question: Harijan Sevak Sangh was founded by ________ in 1932 for the purpose of eradicating the evil called untouchability.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Mahatma Gandhi.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Harijan Sevak Sangh**

__
 
• **Harijan Sevak Sangh** was **founded by Mahatma Gandhi on 30 September 1932** as an all-India organization.
 
• Earlier this organization was named **Untouchability Prevention Sangh**, which was** renamed Harijan Sevak Sangh on 13 September 1933.**
 
• Its **first president was famous industrialist Ghanshyamdas Birla **and secretary Amritlal Vithaldas Thakkar.
 
• The** headquarter of the Sangh is at Gandhi Ashram, Kingsway Camp, Delhi.**
 
• Its branches are in almost all the states in India.
 
• Presently its **chairman is Shankar Kumar Sanyal.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****Narendra Dev**

 
• **Acharya Narendra Dev was a prominent freedom fighter, journalist, litterateur, and educationist in India.**
 
• He was the **main theorist of the Congress Socialist Party.**
 
• Acharya Narendra Dev, the master of extraordinary talent and personality, was a high-quality teacher and a great educationist in the form of a teacher.
 
• After becoming the Acharya of Kashi Vidyapeeth, this title became a part of his name.
 
• Their passion to liberate the country drew him into the freedom movement and the economic condition of India and the plight of the poor made him a socialist.

**Jawaharlal Nehru**

 
• **Jawaharlal Nehru was the first Prime Minister of India** and a central figure in Indian politics before and after independence.
 
• Under the tutelage of Mahatma Gandhi, he emerged as the supreme leader of the Indian independence movement and ruled India from its establishment as an independent nation in 1947 until his death in 1964.
 
• He is considered the architect of the modern Indian nation-state – **a sovereign, socialist, secular, and democratic republic.**

**Aruna Asif Ali**

 
• **Aruna Asif Ali was**** born in a Bengali family** on 16 July 1909 in a place called 'Kalka' in Haryana, then Punjab.
 
• Her family was** Brahmin by caste.**
 
• Her name was** 'Aruna Ganguly'.**
 
• After completing her studies in Lahore and Nainital, she became a teacher and **started teaching at Gokhale Memorial College, Kolkata.**
